description: Camco's Premium 10-Piece Nesting Cookware Set is specifically designed for use in RVs, boats and other compact spaces. Nesting cookware saves valuable space by storing in less than a ½ cubic foot area. This set is made from high quality 18/10 stainless steel with an aluminum core. It is dishwasher safe, compatible with induction cooking and can be used in the oven (when the removable handles are not attached). Stainless steel is low maintenance, difficult to rust and non-reactive. Includes: (1) dome lid, (1) stepped lid, (1) 1.5 qt. saucepan, (1) 2 qt. saucepan, (1) 3 qt. saucepan, (1) 3 qt. sauté pan, (1) 5 qt. stock pot, (2) handles, and (1) storage strap. Measurements when nesting for storage are 13 3/16-inches (W) x 6 7/8-inches (H)—including handles. The pot diameter is 10 ¼-inches—without handles. Camco makes quality products for RVing, boating, camping, towing, tailgating, and grilling that help you take your passion for the outdoors to the next level.
